summary: Both seasons are non-linear samplers of short standalone chapters. S1 (eps 1-12) draws from vols 1-4 in scrambled order - each half-episode is one dagashi chapter (e.g. ep 3 = 9,10,25,20; ep 8 = 58,32,15; ep 12 = 65,64,68,49) - reaching a running max of ch 68 while skipping ~30 chapters (14,17,19,22-23,30,33-38,41,44,46-47,57,59-63,66-67), and ep 10 is an anime-original sick-Hotaru story with only gag fragments (type -> mixed). S2 (eps 13-24, half-length) opens with back-fills (88+60, 89-90, 84), then runs the departure/Hajime arc almost linearly 106-126 with small reorders (121 pulled into ep 20, a ch-113 gag grafted into ep 17, 123 split across eps 22-23) and skips 69-83, 85-87, 91-105, 118, 122. Anchors are built from the fandom wiki (episode pages + chapter reverse-links, chs 1-38 only), a MAL manga-reader's per-episode posts (2016), Inquisitr, and a complete fan list in the WDTALO comments, cross-checked against the featured-dagashi-per-chapter list (caprico-log / ja-Wikipedia) that pins every title-named chapter. Surprises: the S2 finale is better supported at ch 126 than the stored 127 (repair proposed, resume 127 either way), and volume boundaries (none in the DB) are now fully sourced.

repairs.why: Two sources put the S2 finale's last chapter at 126 (Inquisitr: 'manga chapters 125 and 126'; WDTALO: 'stops at Chapter 126'); the only claim for 127 is 'partially adapted for ending' in a WDTALO reader comment. The stored 127 (source 'mu') looks like a 'read from 127' continue point stored as END. Resume stays 127 (continue_points). Medium confidence - see flags.

structure.notes: Two TV seasons only, no OVAs/specials/movies. S1 (AniList 21365) = 12 x 24-min episodes, 2016-01-07..03-31; S2 'Dagashi Kashi 2' (AniList 99734) = 12 x ~12-min episodes (shared 15-min slot with Takunomi., per ja-Wikipedia), 2018-01-12..03-30. Our cumulative 1-24 = S1 1-12, S2 1-12 (offset +12); Wikipedia's EpisodeNumber2 and MAL thread titles confirm. animefillerlist types all 24 as Manga Canon (no filler flagged) - see type correction for ep 10. Volume boundaries (fandom List of Chapters and Volumes; corroborated by ja-Wikipedia per-volume dagashi lists and caprico-log first-appearance numbers): v1 1-18 (+18.5 omake), v2 19-38 (+38.5), v3 39-56, v4 57-74, v5 75-92, v6 93-108, v7 109-124, v8 125-139, v9 140-155, v10 156-170, v11 171-186 (fandom's v11 list omits ch 179 - a typo, 186 chapters total). max_adapted_chapter for the series is 126 (127 if the disputed partial ending counts); S1 max 68, S2 min 60.

flags_for_sean: END convention: per protocol END = last chapter animated in the episode's running order, so S1 anchors dip (ep 8 -> 15, ep 9 -> 18, ep 11 -> 13) because the season is a rearranged sampler; the monotone 'running max + 1' is supplied as continue_points. If the position instrument should instead use the highest chapter reached, use continue_chapter - 1 for eps 3,5,6,8,9,10,11,12,13,15.
Ep 5 ch 40 (Baby-Star Ramen vlog): title + caprico-log first-appearance + WDTALO list say adapted; MAL bastek66's final skipped list (2016-04-01) includes 40. Kept in chapters_adapted.

Ep 11 composition disputed: bastek66 (MAL, manga reader, 2016) calls the second half 'almost whole original' with only the Perry bit from ch 13, and counts 52 and 56 as unadapted; WDTALO fan list gives 13, 50, 52, 56. Not type-corrected (only one explicit source for 'original'); consider 'mixed'.

Ep 16 END 108 rests on the WDTALO fan list alone (106-107 are corroborated by Inquisitr and the MAL thread); Ep 18 (111-112) and ep 21's ch 117 likewise rest on that list plus sequence logic - no second explicit source found for the no-dagashi story chapters 107-112, 114, 117.
Ep 17: the 'Taratara shitenja neyo' dagashi first appears in ch 113 (caprico-log; ja-Wikipedia vol 7 p45), but the WDTALO list gives ep 17 = 109-110 and marks 113 skipped; recorded as a graft of 113.

Ep 24 (outside target range): stored END 127 vs sources 126 (Inquisitr, WDTALO article) / '125-126, 127 partial' (WDTALO comment). Repair to 126 proposed at medium confidence; continue point is 127 either way.
